FFmpeg 9.0.2 for Glimpse (macOS, Apple silicon)

This folder holds the ffmpeg and ffprobe that Glimpse uses and ships inside the app
(Glimpse.app/Contents/Resources/ffmpeg). The two binaries are not in git:
"node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs" downloads them, checks the checksums below and puts them here.

Build:    static GPL v3 build with libx264 by Martin Riedl, https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de
          (signed with his Developer ID, links only system libraries, needs macOS 12 or later)
Version:  9.0.2 (build 1789931890_9.0.2)
Licence:  GNU General Public License version 3, see LICENSE-FFMPEG.txt in this folder
Source:   https://ffmpeg.org/download.html

Downloads and their sha256:
  https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de/download/macos/arm64/1789931890_9.0.2/ffmpeg.zip
    c8ed4c4e6978a03c485edbfe4e0a5dc2380f8a30bba5150531b31b094492d924
  https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de/download/macos/arm64/1789931890_9.0.2/ffprobe.zip
    fcbe839537485eaee7a7a8bc5cbc0f90d53617e80943e8a5b2e31cb851197ea6
